title: Just a Bite
identity: Just a Bite (2011) is for alto saxophone and piano. The composer says it was commissioned by SAMRO for The Book Project, which targets young players at Grade 3–5; Gerber’s University of Pretoria bibliography independently gives the same duration and commission, and describes this edition as a manuscript available from the composer.

evidence.claim: Current composer page identifies Just a Bite (2011) for alto saxophone and piano, 2:00, commissioned by SAMRO for The Book Project for young players at Grade 3–5.

University of Pretoria bibliography identifies an alto saxophone and piano manuscript, 2:00, and SAMRO Grade 3–5 commission; it labels its own performance level III. Underlying repository PDF returned 403 and is represented by indexed text only.
evidence.source_name: Karlien Gerber, An Annotated Bibliography of Selected Classical Saxophone Works by South African Composers

evidence.claim: Noa Even’s performer-maintained repertoire page lists the work at 2:00 for alto saxophone and piano.
SAMRO’s composer archive lists several Loveday scores, but Just a Bite is not among the listed titles on the opened page.

collection_flag: Documented youth-oriented commission: SAMRO’s Book Project was for Grade 3–5 young players. That intended audience is relevant collection context, but does not by itself settle college suitability.
gaps: No readable score or exact saxophone notation/range was found; the manuscript is stated to be available from the composer.
No verified saxophone performance recording located.
Gerber’s chart encodes meter, key signature, tempo, note value, rhythm, articulation and range, but the indexed extract does not provide a legend for its numeric scale; do not interpret the scores.
